text: The night is long in here, and the guards walk past every hour. Keep your voice low, and listen to me carefully.

candidates.instruct: An older man in his fifties with a hoarse, low voice, speaking in a quiet urgent whisper close to the listener, tired but kind, with a slight Russian accent in English.
A gravelly middle-aged male voice, a soft breathy half-whisper, calm and conspiratorial, slow pace, warm.
A cold, flat male voice in his forties, precise and bored, bureaucratic and unhurried, low-mid pitch, no warmth, with a slight Russian accent in English.
A clipped, hard male voice, authoritative and tired, speaking slowly with quiet contempt, deep and dry, close microphone.
An elderly man in his seventies, gentle, patient and warm, slightly frail, a soft low voice of a teacher speaking quietly at night, with a slight Russian accent in English.
An old male scholar with a thin, soft but clear voice, kind, deliberate pace, quietly encouraging.
